instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Build the full-stack FastAPI backend + React Vite frontend in Bahasa Indonesia with MongoDB storage for all mosque settings, prayer times, layouts, slides, running texts, and events.
2. Implement the TV Display at `/display` as a true 16:9 full-screen kiosk (NO scroll, NO scrollbars, huge high-contrast fonts, real-time seconds ticking, Hijri+Gregorian date, WakeLock enabled).

3. Build the modular Layout Engine supporting all 8 distinct templates (SIGNATURE, ULTRA_WIDE, SIMPLICITY, CINEMATIC, HORIZONTAL, VERTICAL, DIGITAL_CLOCK, PRAYER_FOCUS) driven by the active layout config and live customizer.
4. Ensure SIGNATURE layout uses Royal Islamic Blue (#061325, #0B1D3A) with Gold/Amber Accents (#F59E0B, #F6BE3C) and emerald accents.

5. Build `/admin/layouts` as an interactive theme store catalog with 16:9 preview cards, '✓ ACTIVE' badge, 'Preview' modal, 'Use This Layout' button, and a customizable color/font/layout inspector with Live Preview, Save, and Reset.

6. Build all 16 Admin sections with full CRUD and rich sample Indonesian mosque data (e.g., Masjid Raya Al-Muhajirin Jakarta, DKM, Bank Syariah QRIS donation, Imsak/Subuh/Syuruq/Dzuhur/Ashar/Maghrib/Isya schedules, Islamic agenda).
7. Implement the prayer state machine: Regular Display → WAKTU AZAN (sound/animation) at prayer time → IQAMAH Countdown (countdown timer) → Regular Display.
